text.p: Hapoel Taibe, the first-ever club from Israel's Arab sector to play in the country's first division, were relegated to the second division after just one season at the top.
The relegation came after the weekend's round of league fixtures.
Taibe, who were the second division champions last season, have had a miserable campaign in the top flight and, with three matches left, are bottom of the standings.
They are seven points behind 15th-placed Zafririm Holon and 10 points adrift of Hapoel Tel Aviv, who are 14th.
The bottom two sides are relegated. Taibe lost 4-2 at home to Maccabi Haifa on Friday.
